newsitem.title: GHANA: GHANA STOCKS EDGE HIGHER ON LOW TURNOVER.
newsitem.headline: GHANA STOCKS EDGE HIGHER ON LOW TURNOVER.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange edged higher on Wednesday but volume was again low, albeit better than the paltry 13,280 shares traded on Monday.
The GSE All-Share index rose 2.16 points to 402.62.
Volume was 153,300 shares, of which 100,500 were traded in UTC Estates. UTC shares were unchanged, however, at 75 cedis.
Standard Chartered added 100 cedis to 5,300 and Ghana Commercial Bank rose 10 to 630.
Against that, Ashanti Goldfields fell 100 to 21,700 on volume of 300 shares. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
